title: Transformation vs Tradition: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) for Arts and Humanities

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies that compare LLM-generated news articles (prompted by real headlines) against original authenticated news articles to highlight racial discrepancies.
Reviewing studies that evaluate LLM-generated news articles against original articles and analyze generated marketing content for gendered language (e.g., using "man hours" or "chairman").
Reviewing studies that analyze geospatial task outputs to identify geopolitical favouritism, measured by the over-amplification of certain countries based on GDP, stability, or military strength.
